lines: In the night’s loneliness deeper than darkness
I want someone to notice now
Because I want to run away from here
The sunrise seen through the window
The sound that reverberates in the room
I dash out of the dim house
I pack the ordinary that never changes
And head to the usual place
I have no desire to fight
I yearn for dreams and ideals, though they exist
But that too is a distant memory
Cross the clouds and reach me
Illuminate the road I should take
No matter how shattered today may seem
Because I want to keep believing
The distant memory of that day
Even when I can’t move forward
To us who walked and worried together
